deploybot: Pipeline started for release v3.2.0-rc3 -> staging (commit: a1b2c3d4, tag: v3.2.0-rc3). Steps: build → test → lint → smoke. Change window: 2026-03-20 10:00-11:00 UTC. :rocket:
alex: lint step hit a hard timeout during `lint-staging` — job stalled around 18m. Logs:```ERROR: ESLint timed out while processing packages/ui/src/components/*.js
Worker exited after 1200s
trace: node --max-old-space-size=4096 ...```
ci-bot: build status: FAILED — lint-staging #4821 timed out. Artifacts: https://ci/internal/4821/artifacts (logs uploaded).
maria: @alex @sam can you triage quickly? this is in the active change window, we either fix quick or hold the rollout.
sam: quick glance — eslint-plugin-security@5.1.0 rolled into the lockfile on recent deps bump. That version added some heavy AST checks; we've seen slowdowns before. Two options: pin plugin to 5.0.2 or increase lint timeout.
pranay: increasing timeout is fastest to unblock (single pipeline tweak), but if it's a real O(n^2) regression pinning avoids repeat flakiness. Pin PR will need a rebuild though.
alex: I can try pin + small rebuild. Pin PR should be minimal: update package-lock and package.json devDep. If PR lands quickly we rerun. If not, we can temporarily bump timeout to 35m.
sam: agreed. I'll prepare the pin change. Patch:```diff
- "eslint-plugin-security": "^5.1.0"
+ "eslint-plugin-security": "5.0.2"
```
alex: opening PR now — https://git.internal/r/redwood/ui/pulls/987 (pin eslint-plugin-security -> 5.0.2). Running CI on PR.
ci-bot: PR 987 CI: lint OK on PR branch? (queued).
qa-bot: note — if we pin, add a short note in the changelog/release notes: "pin eslint-plugin-security to avoid lint-timeouts in CI".
maria: timeline: if PR CI finishes in <15m we rerun the staging pipeline. If >15m we will increase timeout and rerun to stay inside change window. @pranay can you prepare the timeout patch so it's hot-swappable?
pranay: done — drafted pipeline tweak at infra/ci/pipelines/staging.yml (timeout: lint -> 35m). Will hold until we decide.
alex: PR 987 CI passed — lint step green. Merging to release branch now.

maria: great work, thanks. We'll skip the temporary timeout change.
sam: will follow up with a short postmortem/notes in the release doc explaining the pin and link to PR 987.
